_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::arterial_network#3, and the execution that FALSIFIED its Signal. Junction degree is not checked at all: adding a FOURTH branch node to junction id 1 of upstream one_d_3_artery_network runs the full 50 steps and reaches the result test (FOURWAY_REACHED_RESULT_TEST=1, FOURWAY_DEGREE_DIAGNOSTICS=0); only the numbers move, area at node 1 4.52400282e+02 -> 4.52400289e+02. The two junction diagnostics that do exist are in art_net/4C_art_net_art_junction.cpp and are about something else: a single-member junction gives 'An arterial junction is supposed to have at least two nodes!' (line 97) and an all-outlet junction gives 'Junction (1) has all of its nodes defined as outlets'. The claimed 'inconsistent junction connectivity' appears nowhere (CLAIMED_INCONSISTENT_TEXT=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
